finiteCases.limits: 36 predeclared finite route/mode/seed inputs and normal earned seeds1/2/3, including one predeclared post-failure retry; no seed search or prevented-damage/win attribution. Equal seeds do not pair later random draws once actions change.

initialFindings.unitFixtureFailure: Source-death fixture changed in-memory positions but room setup reapplied configured positions. Fixed both configured and party positions; death/queue assertions retained.
initialFindings.browserFailures: Two initial literal wording expectations used 下一回合 / 下回合仅少排 instead of the shipped 下回合少排至多. Corrected exact text; full config/report/guild/resource/outcome assertions retained.
initialFindings.codeReviewFix: Personal negative-effect summary had labelled all non-dissonance effects as healing blocks. Changed to total harmful applications / of which dissonance, with offbeat actual queue count separate; final browser verifies 2 negative applications and no false 禁疗2. Full tests rerun after fix.

referenceBoundary.verifiedPublicDescription: Official public skill text shows action-count reductions including delayed components. Read successfully via search result link.

Every numeric rule/class assignment is provisional project design; original cost/target count/durations/tables not copied.

limitations: Skill public description is verified; current authenticated server values are not. Numeric and base-action-protection rules are provisional project adaptations.
